text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- International Investment Group wants to establish an Islamic bank.
- Government to impose monitoring programmes to rationalise public spending, Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan says.

- Defence Minister Sheikh Salem Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah in Britain to discuss mutual defence arrangements. Sheikh Salem said earlier in Februray that a decision to buy British Sea Skua missiles worth some $90 million was final and that his ministry had begun taking measures to conclude the deal. Some 16 MPs later requested a full parliament debate of the deal.
